_comment: Cross-dataset topics for the variable list. Seeded from the codebook sections
parsed out of each module codebook, then curated: Demscore's own 13 published
Thematic Datasets were tested against this variable selection and fit it badly
(5 themes empty, 7 variables unplaced including four of the five V-Dem democracy
indices, and all 11 REPDEM variables collapsing into one theme). See
topic_classification.wip.md section 8 in the deployment repo.
A variable may list several topics; the first is its primary one.

democracy.label: Democracy
democracy.description: High-level indices summarising how democratic a country is.

rule_of_law.label: Rule of Law
rule_of_law.description: Legal constraint on power: courts, constitutions and oversight.

corruption.label: Corruption
corruption.description: Bribery, perceived corruption and the quality of public administration.

media.label: Media
media.description: Press freedom, censorship, disinformation and academic freedom.

cabinets.label: Cabinets
cabinets.description: How governments are formed, composed and how long they last.

parliament.label: Parliament
parliament.description: Legislature size, party systems and polarization.

gender.label: Gender
gender.description: Differences in access and opportunity between women and men.

state_capacity.label: State Capacity
state_capacity.description: Administrative effectiveness, monetary independence and militarization.
